label: Semarang
short_description: Central Java's port capital, home to the Dutch colonial Kota Lama old town and the Jalan Pemuda business corridor.
intro: Semarang, Central Java's provincial capital and a historic trading port, pairs a working city center along Jalan Pemuda with the restored Dutch colonial warehouses and church of Kota Lama (the Old Town) a short drive away. Hotel coverage here is business- and mall-oriented, clustered near Paragon Mall and the Jalan Pemuda corridor, with Sam Poo Kong temple and Lawang Sewu among the city's landmark sights. Ahmad Yani International Airport sits about 5km from the city center.
